purpose: Единствен канонски production contract за правни метаподатоци, доказно потекло, јазична исправност и Human Gate.

canonical_metadata.secondary_material_rule: must remain legalAuthority=false and visibly secondary

runtime_release.provider_context: Every legal/quasi-legal context item passes CANONICAL_PROVENANCE_GATE immediately before provider synthesis.
runtime_release.macedonian_output: Every Macedonian-facing AI answer passes deterministic normalisation plus MACEDONIAN_RELEASE_GATE immediately before display.
runtime_release.failure_policy: blocked material is excluded; failed Macedonian output is never shown as a valid answer.
runtime_release.free_latency: Simple FREE informational turns use a short prompt, bounded output and no second provider repair; malformed output fails closed instead of adding slow repair loops.
